item.title: Morocco denies involvement in migrant surge into Spain’s Ceuta
item.description: Over 70,000 migrants entered Ceuta, sparking a humanitarian crisis and political tensions between Spain and Morocco. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: African Parks: When conservation becomes a question of power
item.description: African Parks is dedicated to protecting wildlife on the continent across some vast areas. But the organization faces allegations of human rights abuses by rangers. Now, Prince Harry is stepping down from its board. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: Who is Trump trying to exclude from 2030 US census and why does it matter?
item.description: Census plan would exclude undocumented immigrants and non-green-card holders, deeming them not 'true inhabitants'. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Human cost of violence in South Sudan ‘continues to grow’
item.description: Independent human rights investigators voiced deep concern over growing risks to both civilians and South Sudan’s political transition following their latest fact-finding mission to the world’s youngest nation – their 14th in a decade. Fuente: UN News.

item.title: 25 años del 11/S: el legado de una lucha antiterrorista que ha puesto en jaque los derechos humanos, aseguran expertos
item.description: En el 25 aniversario de los atentados del 11 de septiembre, un grupo de expertos independientes de la ONU rinde homenaje a las víctimas, pero advierte de que un cuarto de siglo de respuestas desproporcionadas ha socavado los cimientos del derecho internacional, la sociedad civil y la democracia. Fuente: Noticias ONU.

item.title: Cambio climático, Cuba, educación, lucha contra el terrorismo… Las noticias del jueves
item.description: La crisis climática ya es una emergencia económica y de seguridad para Europa. La crisis eléctrica de Cuba amenaza las vacunas de 70.000 niños. "El agua nos llega a las rodillas": los peligros climáticos dejaron a millones de niños sin escuela en 2025. pobreza. Un cuarto de siglo de lucha contra el terrorismo ha puesto en peligro los derechos humanos, aseguran expertos. Fuente: Noticias ONU.

item.title: U.K. anti-migrant protesters mistakenly target Pakistan U-19 cricket team hotel: reports
item.description: The incident occurred on September 8 evening in a northern suburb of Portsmouth, some 48 hours after protesters disrupted the disembarkation of scores of migrants near the port city Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Trump administration proposes excluding certain immigrants from US census
item.description: The proposal aims to exclude some legal and undocumented immigrants from the count used to determine US House seats. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: EU gives Spain 115 mn euros aid over Ceuta crisis
item.description: The EU on Wednesday said it was granting Spain 115 million euros ($130 million) in emergency aid to help bolster border security and assist returns after the massive migrant rush into the north African exclave. More than 70,000 migrants crossed into Spanish territory from Morocco on July 30 and 31 in an unprecedented rush that left scores dead, most by drowning as they tried to swim around a breakwater. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Kenya's crackdown on foreign workers raises concern among Burundians
item.description: Some 16,000 Burundian refugees and asylum seekers live in Kenya, and many of them make a living through informal jobs – as carpenters, motorcycle taxi drivers, or clothing vendors. But since Monday, many have been afraid to go to work, and are now looking to leave the country. The reason: remarks made by Kenya’s president, which have sparked deep concern within the Burundian community. More from our correspondent Bastien Renouil. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Temporary protections for about 200,000 Salvadoran immigrants are in limbo as deadline nears
item.description: Temporary legal protections for about 200,000 immigrants from El Salvador are in limbo as a deadline nears for the Trump administration to decide on ending them, as it has done with hundreds of thousands from Venezuela, Haiti and other countries Fuente: The Independent - World.

item.title: Plight of Afghans going ‘from bad to worse’, but the world is looking away: Türk
item.description: Since the Taliban returned to power in 2021, the plight of Afghans has only deteriorated, with millions impoverished while authorities violate basic human rights daily. Fuente: UN News.
